description: List posts on the blog. Defaults to published posts. Pass `status: 'draft'` for drafts.

blog_id.description: Your blog's id, as returned by signup. Optional with an API key: it defaults to the key's blog, and any id you pass must be that blog. Required when the server runs without API keys.

status.description: "published" (default) lists live posts, newest published first; "draft" lists drafts, newest created first.

name: list_posts

error.description: Present only on failure (isError: true). Success fields are absent then.

details.description: Extra context. Keys depend on the code.

message.description: What went wrong and what to do next.

language.description: The post's own BCP-47 language tag. Absent: it uses the blog's language.

publishAt.description: ISO 8601 time a scheduled draft goes live. Absent when not scheduled.

publishedAt.description: ISO 8601 publish time. null for drafts.

translationGroup.description: Shared by every translation of the same post.

title: List posts
